opportunities.point: Management stated that they are planning to launch a plant for soya chunks after two quarters.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Install the capacity later, after 2 quarters." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.

opportunities.point: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of approximately 6 percent from 2024 to 2029.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption." (concall ppt - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 10 -> 16 Cr (Mar 2026) but operating cash flow -2 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -14 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
An overdraft taken on the last day of September contributed to the increase in short-term borrowings.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Actually, mainly there was one OD came on the last day of September. So, that contributed so much towards short-term borrowings." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

threats.point: Management noted that growth targets were not reached last year because of challenges of the new setup and delay in rights.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "and we didn't reach out in the last year that we do because of the challenges of this new setup. It's a huge setup and second thing was the delay in the rights." (concall transcript - 2025-06-01)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
